rules.accepted_credit_types: Practice-focused contact hours accredited by a national or state CE approval body recognized by ASBN (list of accrediting organizations on the board site); ACLS/PALS/NRP/PEARS count 10 hours; CPR/BLS not accepted
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE needed for the first renewal if the first renewal period is shorter than 24 months.
rules.carryover: Hours above the requirement cannot be carried over to the next period.
rules.alternatives: Instead of 15 contact hours: a current national certification or recertification recognized by ASBN, or at least one college credit hour in a nursing course with grade C or better during the licensure period.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; licensee keeps certificates for two renewal periods or 4 years; if short at audit, 90 days to comply, then late fee and reprimand.
rules.notes: Nurses affirm CE on the renewal application and do not upload certificates. CE Broker is the board's optional free tracking tool, not mandatory. Inactive licenses need no CE; reinstatement/late renewal under 5 years needs 20 hours.
